g.text: Is another fashion possible: when design embraces sustainable systems ◆ Ray-Ban launches Marvel eyewear collection ahead of 'Avengers: Doomsday' ◆ Size-inclusive marketplace Viva Voce appoints Amy Williams as CEO ◆ Top Fashion Influencer: Robin de Bree ◆ Leather Working Group appoints Christina Raab as CEO ◆ Maison Margiela and Gentle Monster centre fourth eyewear collaboration on deconstruction ◆
